items.title: Edward "Eddie" Richardson Interview, 1960-10-29
items.q: He'd come and get John Casimir, Joe Casimir and me and the rest of the men would go and play those jobs.

ctx.x: What kind of job do you like best?

Well I prefer dances. I prefer playing in where people are dancing. Those parades are all right but sometimes you get a job and it looks like they walk all over the city. In Carnival Day you've got to be in condition. You've got to be in condition to walk for Carnival Day. Who did you play for on Carnival Day, what clubs? I think it was the Garden District. I remember the Corner Club used to have some bands too. They'd have those rehearsals first. I used to go up there to the channel and hear those people. Yeah…
Do you have any questions, Molly?
